nextStoryContext: US-R4-001 closed the round-3/round-4 WARNING for CAM-482: `makeSpawnSidecarFn` (src/commands/sidecar-liveness-watch.ts), the sidecar-liveness watcher's own respawn of a dead sidecar in container-mode, spawned with `stdio: ['ignore','ignore','ignore']` -- it held no fd on `.claude/cam-supervisor.log`, so `defaultListProcesses`'s process-identity check (`holdsSidecarLogOpen`, US-R2-001, src/commands/stop.ts) never matched it and `cam stop`'s fallback scoped scan silently left a liveness-watch-respawned sidecar running whenever the pid file was absent/stale (the one situation the fallback exists for). Fix: `makeSpawnSidecarFn` now does `openSync(join(cwd, '.claude', SIDECAR_LOG_FILENAME), 'a')` and hands that fd as both stdout and stderr to `Bun.spawn`, byte-for-byte matching `spawnSidecarDefault`'s existing redirection in src/commands/run.ts (which was never broken -- only the later-added liveness-watch respawn path lacked it). `SIDECAR_LOG_FILENAME` is imported from `../supervisor/sidecar-pid.ts` (already exported there, already used by both stop.ts and run.ts) rather than re-declared. `buildSidecarRespawnArgv`, the self-spawn-argv builder, and every other behavior of the watcher (poll/backoff/exhaustion state machine, marker-write-on-exhaustion) are untouched. Test change: `test/integration/stop-defaultlistprocesses-real.test.ts` gained a new standalone real-I/O test ('discovers a liveness-watch-respawned sidecar (US-R4-001 regression)') that builds the respawn argv via the real `buildSidecarRespawnArgv` export, opens the log file the same way the fixed `makeSpawnSidecarFn` does, spawns a real child process with that shape in a real mkdtemp cwd, and asserts `performStop` discovers and SIGTERMs it -- reproducing the exact shape the review's Layer B probe proved invisible (pid B in review-artifact.txt section 3). The pre-existing 3-process test in that file (genuine sidecar / decoy / adjacent-non-sidecar) was left untouched; it already covered `spawnSidecarDefault`'s shape, which was never the bug. No unit test in the repo asserted on `makeSpawnSidecarFn`'s stdio shape directly (it's DI-injected in all existing sidecar-liveness-watch unit tests, so none needed updating -- verified by running test/stop-sidecar-liveness-watcher-kill.test.ts, test/commands/sidecar-liveness-watch.test.ts, test/commands/run-self-spawn-argv.test.ts, and test/supervisor/sidecar-pid.test.ts all green with no changes). File-size: neither touched file crossed its budget ceiling (no scripts/file-size-budget.json edit needed this story). Appended a patterns.md bullet under the sidecar/CAM-482 thread generalizing the lesson: `holdsSidecarLogOpen` is a property of HOW a process is spawned, not something automatically true for every future self-spawn site with matching argv shape -- any NEW real-sidecar self-spawn path added later must be audited against this same requirement at write time, not caught by a later review round. Full quality spine green: typecheck 0 errors, 5935 tests pass (0 fail), check:all (lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet) all ok. This closes the only round-4 finding this agent's spawn prompt carried; the next agent should re-check prd.json/the review artifact for any further round-4 findings before assuming the round is fully clean.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed Bun.spawn's stdio/stdout/stderr option accepts a raw numeric file descriptor (e.g. from node:fs openSync) to redirect output to an already-open file; matches the exact pattern spawnSidecarDefault already used and makeSpawnSidecarFn now mirrors.
